remote_outputs.description: Remote outputs from ESPHome, CAN, or other remote devices.

id.markdownDescription:
Output ID

Custom ID for this remote output. If not set, auto-generated
from device_id + output_id (e.g. "esphome_device_1_relay_1").
id.title: Id

remote_source.markdownDescription:
Remote Source Protocol

Protocol used to control the output:
- esphome_api: ESPHome native API switch/light
- can: CAN bus output control
- mqtt: MQTT switch topic
- wled: WLED HTTP/WebSocket API (main or segment)
remote_source.title: Remote source

device_id.markdownDescription:
Remote Device ID

ID of the remote device (from remote_devices section).
device_id.title: Device id

output_id.markdownDescription:
Output/Entity ID

Switch or light object_id on the remote device (e.g. "relay_1").
output_id.title: Output id

output_type.markdownDescription:
Output Type

Type of output for Home Assistant categorization:
- switch: Generic switch
- light: Light entity
- valve: Valve entity (for irrigation)
- cover: Cover entity (gate, blind, shutter)
output_type.title: Output type

show_in_ha.markdownDescription:
Forward to Home Assistant

Whether to publish HA autodiscovery for this remote output.
Set to false if the ESPHome device already publishes its own entity.
show_in_ha.title: Show in ha

on_disconnect.markdownDescription:
On Disconnect Behavior

What to do when the remote device loses connection:
- ignore: Keep last known state (default)
- turn_off: Force output OFF (safe for pumps/irrigation)
on_disconnect.title: On disconnect

momentary_turn_on.markdownDescription:
Momentary Turn On

After turning ON, auto-OFF after this duration.
momentary_turn_on.title: Momentary turn on

momentary_turn_off.markdownDescription:
Momentary Turn Off

After turning OFF, auto-ON after this duration.
momentary_turn_off.title: Momentary turn off

adjustable_duration.markdownDescription:
Adjustable Duration

Enable an HA number entity (slider) to dynamically set the on-timer.
When ON is pressed, auto-OFF after this duration.
adjustable_duration.title: Adjustable duration

duration_unit.description: Unit displayed on Home Assistant duration slider.
duration_unit.title: Duration unit

interlock_group.markdownDescription:
Interlock Groups

Shared interlock groups with local outputs. When this remote output
is turned ON via boneIO, other outputs in the same group will be
blocked. Direct control from ESPHome/HA bypasses the check unless
enforce_interlock is enabled.
interlock_group.title: Interlock group

enforce_interlock.markdownDescription:
Enforce Interlock on External Changes

When true, if this remote output is turned ON externally (not via
boneIO) and it violates an interlock, boneIO will immediately send
a turn-off command to the remote device.
enforce_interlock.title: Enforce interlock

remote_outputs.title: Remote outputs
remote_outputs.markdownDescription:
Remote outputs from ESPHome, CAN, or other remote devices.

Configure outputs from remote devices. Each entry maps a switch/light
on a remote device to a local output object with full turn_on/turn_off
support. Remote outputs are visible in the Outputs view and can be used
in irrigation zones, output groups, and templates.
